projects.name: face_recognition (ageitgey/dlib wrapper)

projects.license_weights: dlib face-recognition ResNet model: author states public-domain distribution; trained on ~3M faces from FaceScrub + VGG-Face + web scrape (not a clean commercial training corpus under FIR gates).
projects.dataset_taint: HIGH for weights — FaceScrub/VGG-style research corpora and web-scraped identities. Not usable in any FIR commercial training path even if model binary is PD.
projects.fir_relevance: none — does not help FIR-7 occlusion levers, PEFT adapters, retrain campaign, or Golden-150. Already superseded by YuNet+SFace (Apache-2.0).
projects.time_saved_estimate: 0 — integration would cost time and add no occlusion or commercial-clean capability.
projects.traps: Easy accidental pull of research-trained dlib weights into product; poor on children/ethnicity bias documented in README; not occlusion-robust; 2017-era stack vs FIR plan.

evidence.claim: face_recognition package LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Adam Geitgey).
Built on dlib deep face recognition; uses dlib pretrained models.
dlib ResNet face model trained on ~3M faces derived from FaceScrub, VGG dataset, and web scrape; author claims pretrained model public domain.

projects.name: torchvision v0.28.0 (PyTorch Vision)
projects.what_it_is: Standard PyTorch vision library: datasets, transforms/TVTensors, detection/segmentation reference models, IO. Evaluated as training infra for FIR retrain campaign.
projects.license_weights: N/A when used as transforms/training infra only. Reference detection weights (COCO etc.) are separate artifacts — do not mix into commercial face training without review.
projects.dataset_taint: LOW if limited to transforms, DataLoader helpers, and training utilities. Avoid shipping or fine-tuning research FR weights from torchvision.models.
projects.fir_relevance: retrain campaign — transforms, TVTensor pipelines, detection reference code for SCRFD-arch / person→face cascade training on synthetic+consented data.
projects.time_saved_estimate: days of boilerplate for clean training pipeline; v0.28 itself is a minor release (not a paradigm shift).
projects.traps: v0.28 changes are small (transform metadata wrap, string interpolation for resize, NEAREST_EXACT mask fix, GIF decoder safety) — do not expect new face-specific modules. Never pull ImageNet/COCO-pretrained FR-adjacent heads into commercial face path without license/data review.

evidence.claim: torchvision LICENSE is BSD 3-Clause.
v0.28.0 release notes: transforms wrap() metadata, string interpolation param, NEAREST_EXACT mask resize fix, GIF decoder OOB fix — no face-recognition modules.

projects.name: DeepSpeed (deepspeedai/DeepSpeed)
projects.what_it_is: Microsoft/LF distributed training stack (ZeRO, offload, 3D-parallel, MoE, etc.) aimed at very large models.
projects.fir_relevance: retrain campaign optional infra only — not required for planned single rented A100/H100 SCRFD + AdaFace-scale 512-D embedder.
projects.time_saved_estimate: negative — setup/config/debug tax exceeds benefit for small face models on ONE GPU.
projects.traps: Overkill: designed for 100B+ LLM-class training. Face models (IR50/IR101/SCRFD scale) fit in single-GPU memory with vanilla PyTorch + AMP. Complexity, ops JIT, and multi-node assumptions add risk without material speedup on one GPU.

evidence.claim: DeepSpeed LICENSE is Apache License 2.0.
Project positioning: extreme scale DL training (MT-530B, BLOOM, ZeRO for trillion-param class); integrates with Transformers/Lightning for large models.

projects.name: CVLface (mk-minchul/CVLface)
projects.what_it_is: MSU CVLab all-in-one FR research toolkit: multi-GPU Lightning training, AdaFace/ArcFace/CosFace/KP-RPE losses, aligners, HF pretrained model hub, eval on LFW/IJB/TinyFace. Successor home for AdaFace recipes.
projects.license_weights: All published pretrained FR checkpoints trained on WebFace4M/12M, MS1MV2/3, CASIA, VGG2 — research-only dataset licenses; commercial use of weights is tainted regardless of MIT code.
projects.dataset_taint: HIGH for weights. Training recipes document CASIA-WebFace, VGG2, MS1MV2, MS1MV3, WebFace4M, WebFace12M — all research-gated for commercial training. Code can point at synthetic datasets (synthetic.yaml mock exists).
projects.fir_relevance: retrain campaign — reusable TRAINING CODE (losses, PartialFC, Lightning loops, aligners) if run only on synthetic+consented data; discard all pretrained weights. Not for ship path or FIR-7 PEFT on SFace.
projects.time_saved_estimate: 1–3 weeks of training-stack engineering IF team ports recipes onto clean data only; 0 if only tempted by pretrained SOTA boards.
projects.traps: Recipes default to research datasets; HF models advertise SOTA but inherit training-data license. Risk of judge contamination if IJB/eval paths pull InsightFace helpers. PartialFC + multi-GPU assumed — overkill for single-GPU campaign unless useful as reference. Do not use pretrained models as teachers (distillation taint).

evidence.claim: CVLface LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Minchul Kim 2022).
Documents training datasets: CASIA-WebFace, VGG2, MS1MV2, MS1MV3, WebFace4M, WebFace12M; pretrained models on HF named by those datasets.
Performance board lists IR/ViT models trained on WebFace12M/4M, MS1MV2/3, CASIA, VGG2 with AdaFace/ArcFace.

projects.name: AdaFace (mk-minchul/AdaFace)
projects.what_it_is: CVPR 2022 quality-adaptive margin loss for face recognition; official repo with head.py loss, training scripts, and many pretrained IR backbones. FIR retrain campaign already names AdaFace-style loss.
projects.license_weights: All released checkpoints (R18/R50/R100 on CASIA-WebFace, VGGFace2, MS1MV2, MS1MV3, WebFace4M, WebFace12M) are research-dataset-trained → tainted for commercial FIR use.
projects.dataset_taint: Weights: HARD TAINT. Loss math and training-loop structure: clean to reimplement / copy under MIT with attribution. Do not load released .ckpt into any FIR training/eval production path.
projects.fir_relevance: retrain campaign — take LOSS IMPLEMENTATION ONLY (quality-adaptive margin via feature-norm approximation). CVLface is the maintained PartialFC home.
projects.time_saved_estimate: 2–5 days vs re-deriving AdaFace loss from paper alone; weeks if also lifting data loaders (but those assume research .rec datasets — do not).
projects.traps: Pretrained model table is the honey pot; BGR/cv2 input convention differs from InsightFace RGB — easy integration footgun. InsightFace train.rec path in README is a contamination vector. Official home moved to CVLface.

evidence.claim: AdaFace LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Minchul Kim 2022).
Pretrained models table lists CASIA-WebFace, VGGFace2, WebFace4M, MS1MV2, MS1MV3, WebFace12M training sets.
Usage example shows AdaFace head on 512-D embeddings with margin params m/h/s/t_alpha.

projects.name: DCFace (mk-minchul/dcface)
projects.what_it_is: CVPR 2023 Dual Condition Face generator: Stage-1 unconditional ID diffusion (G_id) + Stage-2 dual-condition mixer (G_mix) combining ID image and style image for synthetic labeled FR training sets. FIR-7 already lists DCFace as synthetic-identity candidate.
projects.license_code: NO LICENSE FILE in repository; open GitHub issue #27 (Apr 2024) requesting model/dataset license remains unanswered — treat code as all-rights-reserved / uncleared for commercial reuse until clarified.
projects.license_weights: Pretrained generators distributed via Google Drive without stated license. G_id based on unconditional DDPM trained on FFHQ; G_mix trained using CASIA-WebFace pairs; style bank from real labeled faces (CASIA path in train docs). Released synthetic datasets (dcface_0.5m / 1.2m) also lack clear commercial terms.
projects.dataset_taint: GENERATOR TRAINING: HIGH — FFHQ (dataset metadata CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; many source images NC) + CASIA-WebFace (research-only). SYNTHETIC OUTPUTS: GRAY ZONE — project markets synthetic data as privacy-friendly alternative to web-crawled faces, but no explicit commercial-use grant; community legal consensus unsettled on whether generator training-data licenses poison outputs. FIR should prefer re-training generator on consented/clean data, or independent synthetic stack (e.g. Vec2Face), over shipping prebuilt DCFace weights/outputs into commercial training.
projects.fir_relevance: FIR-7 / retrain campaign — synthetic-identity source candidate (methods + pipeline ideas). Highest material value among synthetic generators reviewed IF license path cleared.
projects.time_saved_estimate: weeks of synthetic-pipeline design if code+weights become license-clear; currently blocked by missing LICENSE — plan alternative or legal review first.
projects.traps: (1) No LICENSE file — commercial code reuse uncleared. (2) FFHQ + CASIA training of generators. (3) Style bank / train path uses InsightFace CASIA packaging. (4) Synthetic inheritance of taint is gray — do not assume 'synthetic = clean'. (5) FR teacher F for ID loss is a frozen pretrained FR model (research-trained).

evidence.claim: DCFace repo file listing has README, install.sh, requirements.txt, assets, dcface/ — no LICENSE file.
Open issue #27 'What is the license?' for model and dataset (Apr 11 2024) with no maintainer license grant in page content.
Training docs: download CASIA-WebFace from InsightFace; place faces_webface_112x112 under DATA_ROOT for generator training.
Paper: G_id is unconditional DDPM trained on FFHQ; dual-condition mixer uses labeled training data; style bank from real faces.

Released synthetic datasets dcface_0.5m and 1.2m via Google Drive without stated commercial license on README.

projects.name: caface (Cluster and Aggregate)
projects.what_it_is: NeurIPS 2022 two-stage feature fusion for multi-image/video probes: Cluster (linear assign N frames → M centers) + Aggregate (fuse M centers) with order-invariant sequential update; designed for large low-quality probe sets (IJB-B/S).
projects.license_weights: Released CAFace ckpt trained on AdaFace WebFace4M backbone + WebFace4M subset features — research-tainted weights.
projects.dataset_taint: HIGH for pretrained CAFace and backbone. Method/code structure clean under MIT if reimplemented or retrained on clean embeddings.
projects.fir_relevance: FIR-7 Slice-0 / template pooling (EMB-02 / EMB-07 quality-weighted multi-image template aggregation) — ideas highly relevant; reimplement quality-aware fusion over SFace 128-D templates rather than load WebFace-trained fusion net.
projects.time_saved_estimate: 3–7 days to reimplement cluster-and-aggregate / quality-weighted pooling from paper+code patterns onto existing 128-D templates; weeks if trying to run their WebFace training path (don't).
projects.traps: Pretrained fusion net is tied to AdaFace-WebFace4M 512-D features — dimension and training-data mismatch with shipped SFace 128-D. InsightFace IJB helpers in eval path. Prefer ideas over weights.

evidence.claim: caface LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Minchul Kim 2022).
README: backbone trained on WebFace4M; CAFace trained on WebFace4M subset; pretrained model + class centers released.
Abstract: Cluster and Aggregate for large-N low-quality probe fusion; order-invariant sequential update; IJB-B/IJB-S.

structuredOutput.summary_for_decision: FIR should treat the Minchul Kim stack as a split: LOSS + TRAINING-CODE recipes (AdaFace MIT, CVLface MIT, caface MIT) are useful if — and only if — all pretrained weights and research datasets (MS1M/WebFace/CASIA/VGG/FFHQ) are hard-excluded from every training and ship path. DCFace is the highest-leverage synthetic candidate already named in FIR-7, but the repo has NO LICENSE, generators were trained on FFHQ+CASIA, and synthetic-output commercial cleanliness is an unsettled gray zone — do not ingest released DCFace weights or 0.5M/1.2M packs into commercial training without legal clearance; reimplement dual-condition ideas on clean generators instead. SapiensID (arxiv 2504.04708) and its CC BY-NC code are useful only as body/torso architecture inspiration (RetinaPatch, SAH), not as dependencies. arxiv 2007.07506 / attend-and-compare is chest-X-ray context modeling — irrelevant. DeepSpeed is overkill for one-GPU face models. face_recognition and deepface expand the horizon but add license traps (dlib research training data; Buffalo_L NC + YOLO AGPL); deepface may serve as a sandboxed multi-judge pool alongside buffalo_l internal-bench, never as ship code. Golden-150 remains the mandatory harness — no new eval framework needed. Net: adopt AdaFace loss + torchvision + reimplemented template-pooling ideas; keep DCFace as design reference pending license fix; ban all listed research pretrained FR/body weights and InsightFace/YOLO backends from commercial paths.
